boards.step1Body: A board holds the tasks of one project. Each column is a stage of the work, such as To do or Done.
boards.step2Body: Drag a task to another column when its stage changes.
boards.step3Body: Select Share to add teammates. They can see and edit every task on this board.

timeline.step1Body: Each bar is a task with a start date and a due date. To group the rows by column or by assignee, use Group by.
timeline.step2Body: Drag a bar to move the task to other dates. Drag the right end of a bar to change only the due date.
timeline.step3Body: Drag from the end of one bar to another bar. The second task then cannot start before the first is done, and Orbitly shows a warning when a date change breaks this order.

guestAccess.title: New: guest access
guestAccess.body: You can now invite people outside your organization as guests. Guests see only the boards you share with them, and they cannot create boards.

errors.boardNameRequired: Enter a name for the board.
errors.uploadTooLarge: This file is larger than 25 MB. Upload a smaller file.
errors.network: Orbitly cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
